lines.zh: 白色的身子在叶脉上挪。
lines.en: My white body creeps along the vein.

lines.zh: 我拱起背，越过一道叶脉。
lines.en: I hump my back over a vein.
The leaf bows under me.
I climb from base to tip.

lines.zh: 我的身体有细细的横纹。
lines.en: Fine bands run across my body.

lines.zh: 我沿叶子边缘走得很慢。
lines.en: I edge along the leaf very slowly.
Dew drips off my fuzz.

lines.zh: 我绕开一只路过的小虫。
lines.en: I go around a passing insect.
I move underneath, where it is cool.
Each segment clings to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我吃过的地方留下网状的痕。
lines.en: Where I feed, a lattice of marks remains.

lines.zh: 我在两片叶子交界停下。
lines.en: I stop where two leaves meet.

lines.zh: 我往叶子中间挪了几寸。
lines.en: I move a few inches toward the middle.

lines.zh: 白色的我，叶子上一道亮痕。
lines.en: White me: a bright line on the leaf.
I squeeze through the leaf's fold.

lines.zh: 白色的身子一节节拱过叶面。
lines.en: My white body humps across the leaf, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 白绒上落了一层细叶屑。
lines.en: Fine leaf dust settles on my white fuzz.
My white fuzz is very clean.
I lift my head toward the light.
I curl slightly.

lines.zh: 叶片上一小块被啃掉了。
lines.en: A small piece of leaf is gone.
I hear wind pass between the leaves.

lines.zh: 我在一片叶子上待了很久。
lines.en: I have been on this one leaf a long time.
I am not moving, yet I am growing.

lines.zh: 细纹在我背上排得整齐。
lines.en: The fine bands line up neatly on my back.
A drop of water on the leaf tip.

lines.zh: 我把嘴在叶脉上磨了磨。
lines.en: I rub my mouthparts on the vein.
Time to eat somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我这么白，你一眼就看见。
lines.en: White, so you spot me at once.
I am the only one on this leaf.
My white fuzz turns grey in the shade.
Do not crush me.
Leaves are my only food.

lines.zh: 你可以把我移到别的叶上。
lines.en: You could move me to another leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬头的时候，脖子会酸。
lines.en: Looking up strains my neck.

lines.zh: 这片叶子够我吃到结蛹。
lines.en: This leaf will feed me until I pupate.
There are no leaves in a bottle.
Look at my fuzz. Very soft.
My body curls into a half ring.
One segment has gone numb.
Green stains my white fuzz.
I held to the leaf a while.
A bit of me flaked away.
I raise my head to look at you.
It hurts, but I do not move.
I can still chew a leaf.
A mark is left on the leaf.
That much is already enough.
That leaf looks tender.
I eat only this one thing.
Set me on that one.
Let it not be dried at the edge.
I smell sap in the vein.
This one lasts me a day.
I do not want fruit at all.
Do not shake it. I would fall.
Closer, so I can sniff it.
I am holding a thin vein.
You touched the leaf; I swayed with it.
Go easy on me.
I nearly lost the leaf.
Do not press my back.
That nudge is nothing.
I moved half an inch.
I am not at the edge.
You pressed my tail.
Let me shift position.
All right. Nothing happened.

lines.zh: 白色绒毛还没变成鳞翅。
lines.en: My white fuzz hasn't become wings.

lines.zh: 我还是一节一节的身子。
lines.en: I am still only segments.
First the chrysalis.
There are others in this wood.
My belly is not full.
That must wait.
Keep away from the leaf edge.
You asked far too soon.
We will speak of it later.
Let me eat my leaf in peace.
I hold a scrap of leaf.
The ground is wet. I will not go down.
It is bigger than I am.
I drag it back with my mouth.
This one's edge is thin.
I found a fine thread.
These crumbs will do.
This is far too heavy.
Not mine. Put it back.
I drag it little by little.
A shadow has fallen on the leaf.
I lift my body a little.
White makes me too visible.
I edge toward the underside.
I slip into the crease.
Something is coming this way.
I bite the stem and dare not let go.
I cannot move just yet.
No cover on this leaf.
Do not climb up onto me.
I lie flat, motionless.
I count the times the leaf sways.

lines.zh: 白色绒毛全都竖了起来。
lines.en: All my white fuzz stands on end.
I move toward the stem.
My white fuzz rises.
I stop on a main vein.
Wait for wind. Wait for wind.
The leaf is wet and slick.
I can no longer hide.
Stay just like this.
I knock my mouth against your boot tip.
I rear up and bump.

lines.zh: 我啃叶边的样子像在打斗。
lines.en: Me chewing the leaf edge looks like a fight.
I only broke a vein.

lines.zh: 我拿头去顶，像顶一片叶。
lines.en: I butt my head, as if at a leaf.
That was like a tickle.
I spin out a thread of silk.
I bump against your nail.
I retreat again.
You would not even notice.
I am on the underside of this leaf.
My white body is beaded with dew.
I emerged from the shell.
The leaf is wide enough to walk.

lines.zh: 白身子从裂开的壳里探出。
lines.en: My white body pushes out of the split shell.
Jungle green sets off my white.
I lift my head for the midrib.
The leaves here are tender.
I stir very slightly.
I begin to chew the leaf.
The heat has browned my white.
I slid off the leaf.
Water wraps all of me.
The blast flings the leaf high.
The arrowhead scraped the leaf.
This light makes me shine.
I have eaten the leaf hollow.
The flash lights the whole wood.
The leaf is gone. I am falling.
